 SHOW Sasha Lacuna pens heartfelt message ahead of The Miss Globe 2026 coronation
 Jefferson Fernando · 6 November 2026 · 9:55 AM PHT · 2 MIN READ 
 All set for the 2026 The Miss Globe Pageant
 Sasha Lacuna / Facebook
 Text size A− Reset A+ Save Philippine representative Sasha Lacuna is ready to carry the hopes and dreams of her fellow Filipinos as she prepares to take the international stage for the coronation night of The Miss Globe 2026.
 Hours before the much-awaited competition, the Filipina beauty queen shared an emotional message on social media, expressing her gratitude for the opportunity to represent the country while reflecting on the values that define the Filipino spirit.
 “Today, I take the Philippines to the Globe,” Sasha declared in her Facebook post.
 For Sasha, competing internationally is more than a personal achievement. It is an opportunity to showcase the determination, courage, and resilience of Filipinos who continue to pursue their dreams despite life’s challenges.
 “It has always been such an honor to represent the heart of a Filipina; our passion, our resilience, our determination, and that unshakable spirit that pushes us to keep going, dream bigger, and give our very best no matter the circumstances,” she wrote.
 The beauty queen emphasized that these qualities have become her source of inspiration throughout her pageant journey.
 “These are the things I carry with me wherever I go, and today, I hope to let the world see a little piece of what makes us Filipino,” she added.
 As she prepares for one of the most important moments of her pageant career, Sasha also dedicated her upcoming performance to the Filipino people, particularly those who have supported and believed in her.
 “So, Philippines, this one’s for you. I’ll walk onto that stage with our flag in my heart, your voices and stories in my mind, and the strength of every Filipino who believes in me,” she shared.
 She concluded her message with a patriotic declaration: “Mabuhay ang Pilipinas!”
 Sasha’s heartfelt words reflect her determination to make the country proud as she competes against international delegates for the prestigious crown.
 With the coronation show approaching, the Philippine bet hopes to leave a lasting impression not only through her beauty and stage presence but also through the Filipino identity and values she proudly represents.
